core_aesthetic_takeaways: The source is useful as a method reference for extracting poster grammar, not as a visual asset source.
Poster prompts become stronger when metaphor, type hierarchy and content slots are separated.
A source visual can inspire mood and structure only after official marks, names and copyrighted layout are excluded.
For AI-generated posters, visible text must be locked before style and texture are described.
Series posters need a repeatable framework: central metaphor, palette rules, text zones and variation logic.
prompt_structure_lessons: Start with the new event brief and never default to the source event.
Define replaceable variables before visual style.
Name the central metaphor and explain its emotional role.
Lock title, subtitle, edition, metadata and logo placeholder policy.
Add negative controls for copied official marks, watermarks, pseudo text and source-layout cloning.

safe_exact_text_candidates: edition or year supplied by the user
placeholder strings such as EVENT NAME, AWARD TITLE, YEAR and LOGO MARK
requires_source_confirmation: small poster metadata and sponsor names
text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use for poster prompt structure and QA. Do not memorize official campaign copy, marks or the article's reusable prompt examples as exact output text.

risk_controls.mitigation: Use grammar-level extraction only; require a new theme and new content slots.
Use brand mark placeholders unless the user supplies authorized assets.
Lock exact visible text first and keep microcopy schematic or editable.
Require a central metaphor, restraint, hierarchy and originality QA.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: Keep as metadata-only poster prompt reference.
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: Use for design-language extraction and prompt-slot governance.
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: Only ingest images if rights are cleared; otherwise retain as prompt methodology memory.
recommended_training_use.stage_4_prompt_runtime: Retrieve when prompts mention GPT-image2 poster, award key visual, design language extraction, event poster template or AI poster QA.
